description: This file contains unit tests for the AssistantTextParser component, including tests for segment splitting, handling of tags, visibility filtering, and content analysis.

classes.name: AssistantTextParserTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test methods for verifying AssistantTextParser's behavior.

methods.name: splitsThinkAndFinalSegments
methods.description: Tests that the parser correctly splits input into 'thinking' and 'final' segments based on tags.

methods.name: keepsTextWithoutTags
methods.description: Verifies that untagged text remains as a single response segment.

methods.name: ignoresThinkingLikeTags
methods.description: Ensures that tags resembling 'thinking' are properly handled and do not affect response detection.

methods.name: dropsEmptyTaggedContent
methods.description: Checks that empty tag contents are ignored and do not produce segments.

methods.name: hidesThinkingSegmentsFromVisibleOutput
methods.description: Ensures that segments marked as 'thinking' are not included in visible outputs.

methods.name: thinkingOnlyTextIsNotVisibleByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that 'thinking' segments are hidden unless explicitly included.
